status: diagnostic screening passed; no production change accepted

protocol.stage: Native projection diagnosis only; no production or VM candidate
protocol.specific: On isolated generated Native C, pack only the completed title array in place as pointer/slot/generation (same16-byte cells), restore original complete references at every function cleanup, and recover provenance from the validated owning heap for loaded roots. Preserve array capacity and64MiB. The diagnostic collector aborts BEFORE tracing if collection starts while packed; there is no GC bypass. All original source algorithms, commands and outputs stay unchanged. Conversion/restoration are included in elapsed time. Separate ledger/count variants assert zero allocations and bytes at every original return, no added allocation calls, matching comparison counts, one pack/restore and full slot identity on conversion/restoration. The production solution would still need general GC/mutation/hostile validation and VM integration.
protocol.measurement: One fixed three-warmup plus eleven alternating fresh-process pairs per original size; coarse search/setup/cleanup phase medians and process elapsed. Three quiet host snapshots10s apart then process/power/thermal checks after each pair, reject any foreign compute or gap>15s. Preserve every observation; no favorable rerun.
protocol.decision_gate: Pursue a production design only if total Native pair geometric latency ratio<=0.90, each total row ratio<=0.95, each search-phase ratio<=0.90, all correctness/ledger/counter/host/hash guards pass. These are screening thresholds, not full32 acceptance or parity. Failed screening keeps production unchanged.
protocol.deliverable: Raw scripts, generated patch, hashes, complete observations, interpretation and bounded next action in indexed evidence; six documentation/architecture/memory gates; commit and push main preserving foreign files.
